Be specific about ethnicity, age, hair, eyes, clothing, and pose. Format the output as plain comma-separated Stable Diffusion tags: begin with masterpiece, best quality, professional portrait, then the character details. Never wrap any part in square brackets (in Stable Diffusion, square brackets DE-emphasize a term); use round parentheses only when you deliberately want to emphasize a term.
